items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: And Dave came in, you know. And Dave went on in the control room. He say, "You got it."

ctx.x: And when we walked in, because they say, "Well, who's conducting the date?" Because they didn't know.
I walked in and I say, "Well I am," you know. And Dave came in, you know. And Dave went on in the control room. He say, "You got it."
"You got it, Teddy, take it," you know. So we started on "You Showed Me The Way"
